issues.title: Configure Spring Boot 3.2 scaffolding, Docker multi-stage build & CI workflow
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Setup the foundational build, packaging, and CI pipelines for User-Service to ensure clean local and containerized development using Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.2.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure `pom.xml` with dependencies for Spring Boot 3.2, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Spring Data Redis, Lombok, and Flyway
- [ ] Setup multi-environment configuration: `application.properties`, `application-test.properties`, and `application-prod.properties`
- [ ] Create multi-stage `Dockerfile` (build layer with Maven cache + distroless/temurin runtime)
- [ ] Configure `docker-compose.yml` with PostgreSQL 15 and Redis 7 services including healthchecks
- [ ] Create GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) to run `mvn clean verify` on push and PR

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Application compiles and boots cleanly via `mvn spring-boot:run`
- [ ] `docker compose up` spins up User-Service, PostgreSQL, and Redis with healthy container status
- [ ] Spring Actuator `/actuator/health` returns HTTP 200 `{"status":"UP"}`

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Java 21, Spring Boot 3.2, PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7
- Estimated Effort: 1.5 - 2 days

issues.title: Implement Flyway migrations, JPA entities & repositories for users and profiles
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Establish persistent domain models for user accounts, creator profiles, and audit records with strict database constraints and automated migrations.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Setup Flyway migration `V1__init_users_schema.sql` defining `users`, `user_profiles`, `user_consents`, and `audit_logs` tables
- [ ] Implement JPA entity `User` with Lombok annotations (`@Data`, `@Builder`, `@NoArgsConstructor`, `@AllArgsConstructor`)
- [ ] Implement JPA entity `UserProfile` with fields: `creator_style`, `default_language`, `default_tone`, `bio`
- [ ] Implement JPA auditing with `@CreatedDate` and `@LastModifiedDate` on all entities
- [ ] Create `UserRepository` and `UserProfileRepository` extending `JpaRepository` with custom lookup methods

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Flyway runs migrations cleanly on boot without errors
- [ ] JPA entities enforce unique constraints (e.g. `email` unique) and foreign key relationships
- [ ] Repository unit tests pass with in-memory H2 / test database

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Follow Repository pattern specified in CLAUDE.md
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement Spring Security 6, JWT provider & Redis token revocation blocklist
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Implement stateless authentication with JWT tokens (access and refresh tokens) and Redis-backed session revocation to satisfy secure access and instant logout requirements.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure Spring Security 6 `SecurityFilterChain` with stateless session management and CORS/CSRF configurations
- [ ] Implement `JwtTokenProvider` generating signed JWT access tokens (15m TTL) and refresh tokens (7d TTL)
- [ ] Implement `JwtAuthenticationFilter` to validate Bearer tokens on incoming requests and set `SecurityContext`
- [ ] Configure `BCryptPasswordEncoder` (strength 12) for secure credential hashing
- [ ] Integrate Redis token blocklist: store revoked tokens with TTL on logout to instantly reject compromised or logged-out tokens

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Requests to protected endpoints without valid Bearer token return HTTP 401 Unauthorized
- [ ] Authenticated requests with valid JWT succeed and populate user identity in `SecurityContextHolder`
- [ ] Logging out adds token to Redis blocklist; subsequent calls with that token fail immediately with HTTP 401

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Integrates with Redis 7
- Estimated Effort: 2 - 2.5 days

issues.title: Implement user authentication, registration & profile management REST APIs
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Provide user-facing REST endpoints for account registration, credential authentication, token rotation, and profile customization.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Define request/response DTOs with Jakarta validation (`RegisterRequest`, `LoginRequest`, `TokenRefreshRequest`, `UserProfileDTO`)
- [ ] Implement `AuthController`:
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/register` - Create user account, hash password, return 201 Created
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/login` - Authenticate credentials, return access + refresh tokens
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` - Validate refresh token and issue new access token
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` - Revoke tokens via Redis blocklist
- [ ] Implement `UserController`:
  - `GET /api/v1/users/me` - Fetch authenticated user profile
  - `PUT /api/v1/users/me` - Update creator preferences (tone, language, style)
- [ ] Implement `@ControllerAdvice` global exception handler returning standard RFC 7807 ProblemDetail responses

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Validation errors (e.g. invalid email, short password) return HTTP 400 with field-level details
- [ ] Successful registration returns sanitized user profile without sensitive fields (password hash)
- [ ] MockMvc controller tests verify all HTTP status codes and error paths

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Requires JWT Provider & JPA Repositories
- Estimated Effort: 2 - 2.5 days

issues.title: Implement DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR compliance (consent tracking, data export & erasure)
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Satisfy legal and regulatory requirements under India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and GDPR, including explicit consent records, data portability, and the Right to Erasure.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement `POST /api/v1/users/consent` recording explicit consent timestamp, IP address, consent type (`VOICE_CLONING`, `MARKETING`, `TERMS`), and policy version
- [ ] Implement `GET /api/v1/users/consent` returning current active consents for the user
- [ ] Implement GDPR Right to Data Portability: `GET /api/v1/users/export` generating comprehensive JSON export of all user data
- [ ] Implement GDPR / DPDP Right to Erasure: `DELETE /api/v1/users/me` initiating account anonymization/soft-deletion and revoking active sessions
- [ ] Store audit trail in `audit_logs` table with immutable timestamps

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Explicit consent records are persisted and verifiable by downstream services (e.g. Voice Service for voice cloning)
- [ ] Data export returns valid, machine-readable JSON containing user profile, consent records, and activity metadata
- [ ] Deletion marks account deleted, immediately invalidates credentials, and writes audit record

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Compliance requirement from PRD Section 10
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement database models & Alembic migrations for subscription tiers & quotas
issues.description:

- [ ] Create `SubscriptionPlan` model (tier, name, price_cents, monthly_video_minutes, monthly_voice_chars, max_storage_mb)
- [ ] Create `UserSubscription` model (user_id, plan_id, stripe_customer_id, stripe_subscription_id, status, current_period_end)
- [ ] Create `UsageRecord` model (user_id, period_start, period_end, video_minutes_used, voice_chars_used, storage_mb_used)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `alembic upgrade head` creates all tables and constraints without errors
- [ ] Initial migration seeds Free, Pro, and Enterprise plan records
- [ ] Downgrade migration cleans up tables properly

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Follow models / schemas pattern in CLAUDE.md
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement real-time quota tracking & atomic rate-limiting with Redis
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Enforce subscription plan quotas with sub-millisecond latency using Redis atomic counters to prevent resource abuse across microservices.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement Redis Lua scripts for atomic check-and-consume quota operations (`quota:{user_id}:{metric}:{period}`)
- [ ] Build internal endpoint `POST /api/v1/quota/check-and-consume`:
  - Validates if user has remaining quota for requested amount (e.g. 2 video minutes, 1500 voice characters)
  - Atomically increments usage if under limit; returns 402/429 with remaining quota if limit reached
- [ ] Build endpoint `GET /api/v1/subscriptions/{userId}/usage` returning current usage vs plan limits
- [ ] Implement periodic background task (or Celery/FastAPI task) syncing Redis usage counters to PostgreSQL `usage_records`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Quota check executes in under 5ms via Redis
- [ ] Race conditions prevented during concurrent generation requests
- [ ] Exceeding quota returns HTTP 402 Payment Required with clear upgrade call-to-action

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Redis 7 Lua scripting
- Estimated Effort: 2 - 2.5 days

issues.title: Implement Stripe billing integration & customer checkout sessions
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Integrate Stripe billing SDK to enable seamless upgrades from Free to Pro and Enterprise tiers, plus customer portal access.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Initialize Stripe Python SDK with API keys and webhook secret
- [ ] Implement `POST /api/v1/billing/create-checkout-session`:
  - Creates or retrieves Stripe customer for authenticated user
  - Generates Stripe Checkout Session URL with success/cancel redirect URLs
- [ ] Implement `POST /api/v1/billing/create-customer-portal-session`:
  - Generates Stripe Customer Portal session URL for updating payment methods and viewing invoices
- [ ] Build Pydantic schemas for request validation and response serialization

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Checkout endpoint returns valid Stripe URL redirecting to Stripe payment page
- [ ] Customer portal endpoint returns valid Stripe portal session URL
- [ ] Stripe API exceptions handled with structured HTTP 400/502 responses

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Stripe API Python SDK
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement Stripe webhook handler & subscription lifecycle state management
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Process real-time Stripe lifecycle webhooks to update user subscription status, renew quotas on invoice payment, and handle cancellations.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement `POST /api/v1/billing/webhook` endpoint with raw body payload parsing
- [ ] Cryptographically verify Stripe webhook signature (`stripe.Webhook.construct_event`)
- [ ] Handle core Stripe events:
  - `checkout.session.completed` - Activate subscription and link Stripe customer
  - `customer.subscription.updated` - Handle plan upgrades, downgrades, and renewals
  - `customer.subscription.deleted` - Revert user to Free tier upon cancellation
  - `invoice.payment_succeeded` - Reset monthly quota counters in Redis and DB
  - `invoice.payment_failed` - Mark subscription past-due and notify user
- [ ] Implement idempotency checking using webhook event IDs to prevent duplicate processing

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unsigned or forged webhook payloads return HTTP 400 Bad Request
- [ ] Valid webhooks update `user_subscriptions` and flush cached tier in Redis
- [ ] Idempotent handler ignores duplicate events safely

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Critical for billing reliability
- Estimated Effort: 2 - 2.5 days

issues.title: Implement PostgreSQL schema, migrations & repository layer for scripts

### Dependencies & Technical Notes

issues.title: Implement OpenAI API integration & multi-tone prompt engineering engine
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Build the core script generation engine using OpenAI API with prompt templates supporting beginner, professional, casual, and respectful tones with structured JSON outputs.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Initialize OpenAI SDK client with API key, timeout, and exponential backoff retry policy
- [ ] Implement modular prompt templates supporting tones:
  - `beginner`: Clear, jargon-free explanations with simple metaphors
  - `professional`: Authoritative, structured, industry-standard insights
  - `casual`: Conversational, engaging, punchy hook, relatable pacing
  - `respectful`: Formal, polite, informative delivery
- [ ] Add multi-language prompting with language auto-detection or explicit target language parameter
- [ ] Enforce OpenAI structured outputs (JSON Schema mode) returning:
  - `hook`: First 3-5 seconds high-retention opening
  - `scenes`: Array of scene blocks with `text`, `visual_cue`, and `pacing`
  - `call_to_action`: Closing CTA
  - `estimated_duration`: Predicted spoken seconds

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generated scripts conform 100% to scene JSON schema
- [ ] Tone variations produce noticeably distinct voice, vocabulary, and sentence structures
- [ ] API timeouts or rate limits trigger retries without failing immediately

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- OpenAI API (GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini)
- Estimated Effort: 2 - 2.5 days

issues.title: Implement script generation & management REST endpoints with Redis caching
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Expose REST API endpoints for generating, reading, editing, and deleting scripts, coupled with a Redis caching layer to maximize read performance.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement REST endpoints in `src/controllers/script.controller.ts`:
  - `POST /api/v1/scripts/generate` - Trigger AI generation with topic, tone, language
  - `GET /api/v1/scripts/:id` - Retrieve script by ID
  - `GET /api/v1/scripts/user/:userId` - List user's scripts with pagination
  - `PUT /api/v1/scripts/:id` - Update script scenes or manual text edits
  - `DELETE /api/v1/scripts/:id` - Delete script
- [ ] Integrate Redis caching layer:
  - Cache script reads with key `script:{id}` (TTL: 2 hours)
  - Invalidate `script:{id}` and `script:{userId}` on updates or deletions
- [ ] Add Zod validation schemas for all inputs and DTOs

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/scripts/generate` returns structured script within SLA (<15s)
- [ ] Subsequent `GET /api/v1/scripts/:id` calls hit Redis cache (<10ms latency)
- [ ] Edits invalidate cached data and update database synchronously

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Redis 7, OpenAI Prompt Engine, Script Repository
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement Kafka event producer for script lifecycle events (script.generated)
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Publish domain events over Apache Kafka to notify downstream services (Voice-Service, Analytics-Service) whenever a script is generated or updated.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Configure `kafkajs` producer client with reconnection logic and graceful shutdown hooks
- [ ] Define Avro / JSON event schemas for:
  - `script.generated`: Contains `script_id`, `user_id`, `project_id`, `scenes`, `language`, `tone`, `word_count`, `timestamp`
  - `script.updated`: Emitted on manual script edits
- [ ] Implement `EventPublisherService` with retry logic and dead-letter queue (DLQ) logging
- [ ] Dispatch `script.generated` event automatically upon successful completion of script generation

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Successfully produced events arrive at `script.generated` Kafka topic
- [ ] Event payloads strictly adhere to schema definition
- [ ] Kafka broker downtime does not crash Express server (logged with fallback)

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Kafka 3.x, kafkajs
- Estimated Effort: 1.5 - 2 days

issues.title: Implement database models & Alembic migrations for voice profiles & audio metadata

issues.title: Implement ElevenLabs TTS API client & audio stream processing engine

- ElevenLabs API

issues.title: Implement voice cloning pipeline (GPT-SoVITS) with DPDP consent verification
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Build custom voice cloning integration using GPT-SoVITS with mandatory explicit consent enforcement compliant with India's DPDP Act 2023.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement sample upload endpoint `POST /api/v1/voice/clone/sample`:
  - Validates audio format (WAV/MP3), duration (10-60s), and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)
- [ ] Enforce DPDP Act 2023 compliance check:
  - Verify active, signed `VoiceConsentRecord` exists before accepting training samples
  - Reject cloning requests with HTTP 403 Forbidden if explicit consent is missing
- [ ] Integrate with GPT-SoVITS inference service to adapt voice embeddings
- [ ] Implement voice deletion endpoint `DELETE /api/v1/voice/{id}` permanently deleting model weights and training samples (Right to Erasure)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Voice cloning strictly blocked without recorded user consent
- [ ] Valid sample initiates model adaptation and creates custom `VoiceProfile`
- [ ] Voice deletion permanently removes all model files and samples, writing audit log

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- DPDP Act 2023 compliance requirement (PRD Section 10)
- Estimated Effort: 2.5 - 3 days

issues.title: Implement Kafka consumer (script.generated) & producer (voice.generated)
issues.description:

Connect Voice-Service to the event pipeline: consume `script.generated` to trigger voiceover generation, and publish `voice.generated` upon completion.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement Kafka consumer using `aiokafka` subscribing to `script.generated` topic
- [ ] Parse incoming script scenes and trigger voice generation per scene or combined narrative
- [ ] Extract scene-level audio timestamps for downstream subtitle and B-roll synchronization
- [ ] Publish `voice.generated` event with payload:
  - `script_id`, `voice_id`, `audio_url`, `duration_seconds`, `scene_timestamps`, `mos_score`
- [ ] Implement dead-letter queue (DLQ) publishing `voice.failed` on unrecoverable generation errors

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Consuming `script.generated` automatically triggers end-to-end voice synthesis
- [ ] `voice.generated` published with accurate timestamp alignment per scene
- [ ] Consumer handles broker reconnection and offset commits cleanly

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- Kafka 3.x, aiokafka
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement MOS voice quality scoring engine & Redis audio metadata caching
issues.description:
### Context & Objective
Evaluate synthetic voice quality using Mean Opinion Score (MOS) metrics to guarantee audio quality parity with PRD target (>4.0 MOS), with Redis caching for repeated synthesis.

### Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement MOS quality estimator assessing acoustic clarity, naturalness, and audio artifacts
- [ ] Flag generations with MOS < 3.8 for automated retry or fallback voice selection
- [ ] Implement Redis caching:
  - Cache voice metadata under `voice:{voiceId}` (TTL: 24h)
  - Cache generated audio by text hash under `voice:audio:{hash}` (TTL: 2h) to avoid re-synthesizing identical text
- [ ] Expose metrics endpoint reporting average MOS scores per voice provider

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] MOS score calculated for every audio generation and recorded in DB
- [ ] Audio with MOS < 3.8 logged as warning and triggers retry
- [ ] Redis cache serves previously synthesized audio without calling ElevenLabs API

### Dependencies & Technical Notes
- PRD Section 9 Non-Functional Requirements (MOS > 4.0)
- Estimated Effort: 2 days

issues.title: Implement Pytest test suite with audio mock fixtures & consent validation tests
